description.value:
In the opening round of a fight, you act twice: once on your normal initiative count, and again ten points lower. This doesn't work if you were surprised.

You've also learned to turn a fall into a weapon: whenever you drop at least 50 feet and come down within 5 feet of an enemy, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against it. If that attack qualifies as a Sneak Attack, you add three extra weapon damage dice to it, and the target must succeed on a Dexterity save against your Deft Hands save DC or be knocked prone.
